bullets.text: In Tiruvallur, a youth from Cuddalore was murdered and buried at Ponneri beach, and police solved the crime.
Near Puzhal, a rashly driven MTC bus hit a two-wheeler, killing a 49-year-old woman going to the hospital.
The Greater Chennai Corporation Council approved biomining works at Kodungaiyur and Perungudi and maintained ICCC services.
In Chennai, a case was registered against two female wardens for harassing a plus-one student from Alandur.
In Tiruvallur, police arrested two individuals for the murder of an employee's son whose body was buried at Ponneri beach.
In Gummidipoondi, police arrested three people after they issued death threats to a sub-inspector during vehicle checks.
In Tiruvallur, fishermen were barred from going to sea as a safety measure before a rocket launch from Sriharikota.
The Tamil Nadu government allocated 125 crore rupees in the first phase for AI-assisted devices for disabled persons.
Larsen and Toubro broke ground on a new 52MW data center facility in Tamil Nadu through its cloud unit Vyoma.AI.
The Supreme Court directed MeitY to enforce strict rules and penalties against unauthorized extraction and use of court proceedings.
Infosys expanded its Pocharam Development Center in Hyderabad by adding 1.1 million square feet and ten thousand seats.
